name: Hold the door: she holds it, you let her through
body: Keep the room. She holds the door plate and waits for you to stand on the plate beyond it, then follows through and meets you. At the chasm you hold the bridge plate on the far side for her.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the prototype rooms and the crossing (#107, #108).

acceptance_criteria: She holds plate one until you stand on the far plate
She crosses the bridge while you hold its far plate
Timed plates remain as the quick solo way across
